title: Only 7% Pass This Car Mechanic Quiz
summary: Warning lights, hidden faults and strange road symptoms test whether you can diagnose trouble before it gets expensive.

landing.intro: From warning lights to strange noises, prove you can find the fault before the repair bill arrives.

about.body:
This worldwide entertainment test contains ten practical questions about vehicle systems, workshop judgement and fault finding. It moves from familiar warning signs to connected symptoms that require careful diagnosis.

Choose the best answer from the information shown. The questions use broad vehicle principles and avoid assuming one make, model or local inspection standard.

Your score reflects this short challenge only. It is not a trade qualification, safety inspection or substitute for diagnosis by a qualified mechanic.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Complete ten carefully selected questions in one focused challenge.
Choose one answer each time. Correctness remains hidden until the final reveal.
Reveal your result, skill breakdown and complete answer review after the final question.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not a professional qualification or vehicle-repair diagnosis. Vehicles differ; consult the manufacturer’s guidance and a qualified technician.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your mechanic score and six-system breakdown are ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Master Diagnostician
profile-1.copy: You connected symptoms, systems and safety decisions with exceptional precision. Even the final multi-step faults rarely sent you down the wrong diagnostic path.

profile-2.title: The Workshop Natural
profile-2.copy: You read warning signs confidently and understood how the major vehicle systems work together. Your diagnostic instincts stayed reliable as the jobs became more demanding.

profile-3.title: The Skilled Fault Finder
profile-3.copy: You found most of the Service Bay’s important clues and handled a broad mix of systems well. A few specialist faults kept the workshop interesting.

profile-4.title: The Practical Problem-Solver
profile-4.copy: You have a useful map of everyday vehicle systems and a sensible approach to diagnosis. Your strongest rounds show where your hands-on knowledge really clicks.

profile-5.title: The Hands-On Learner
profile-5.copy: You identified a solid share of the workshop faults across very different systems. Some clues were familiar immediately, while others are ready for another look.

profile-6.title: The Curious Car Owner
profile-6.copy: The Service Bay uncovered some knowledge gaps, but it also showed where your automotive instincts are strongest. Every missed fault is another useful clue to learn.

mech-r1q1.question: Which warning symbol most directly relates to engine oil pressure?

mech-r1q2.question: A red brake warning stays on after the parking brake is released. What is the safest response?
answers: Stop safely and have the brake system checked
Ignore it until the next service

mech-r4q5.question: A rhythmic clicking becomes faster on tight turns. Which part is a likely cause?

mech-r4q6.question: One tyre has a deep sidewall bulge. What should you do?
answers: Stop using the tyre and arrange replacement

mech-r5q5.question: The engine overheats in traffic but cools at road speed. Which component deserves an early check?

visual.ariaLabel: Expected battery voltage 12.6 volts, measured 10.5 volts

mech-r6q1.question: A healthy 12-volt battery reads about 12.6 V at rest. This one reads 10.5 V. What does that suggest?
answers: The battery is deeply discharged or has a failed cell

mech-r7q1.question: The steering wheel vibrates mainly at one road-speed range. What is a likely first suspect?

mech-r7q6.question: A new severe vibration appears after striking a road hazard. What should you do?
answers: Increase speed to smooth it out
Stop safely and inspect the wheel and tyre before continuing
Ignore it if no warning appears

mech-r9q2.question: “The battery is new, but it repeatedly goes flat and the charging warning appears while driving.” What should be tested?
answers: The charging system and its connections

visual.ariaLabel: Engine cools at road speed, overheats at idle, cooling fan does not run

mech-r10q4.question: The engine overheats only at idle, the radiator is unobstructed and the cooling fan never runs. What should be diagnosed first?
answers: The fan circuit, motor and control command
